text:
The passage employs personification to transform the classroom clock into a "stern schoolmaster," symbolizing the rigid, authoritative structure of the educational environment. The "ticking hands" represent an unyielding force that governs time, suggesting that the students are not in control of their own schedules but are instead subject to an external, mechanical discipline. The phrase "temporal grip" metaphorically conveys the pressure and constraint students feel, where time is not just a measurement but an active agent that dictates the rhythm of their lives, creating a sense of entrapment or strict regulation within the academic setting.

Regarding your priority question: The animal typically regarded as man's best friend is the dog.
